correctness.rationale: A non-squarefree cubic has exactly one repeated linear root. Odd characteristic yields a reversible bijection between simultaneous repeated-root pairs and d != 0, t with d^3=ut+2v. In characteristic two it yields a square-map bijection and condition au=v. Inclusion--exclusion proves C_q exactly and the cube map kernel gives all shift frequencies. A standard-library verifier independently enumerates cubic gcd squarefreeness across 293 cases over 11 fields; this is finite corroboration, not proof.

Carmon--Rudnick and Carmon treat sign correlation and/or bounds, whereas Bary-Soroker--Stix treat simultaneous irreducibility. Multiple targeted scientific record and published-literature searches uncovered no exact affine-shift covariance formula. A broader implicit historical formula remains possible.

value.rationale: An exact q- and shift-uniform two-point squarefree covariance formula for all monic cubics gives a complete natural distribution over q^2-1 affine shifts. It reveals genuine cubic-residue and characteristic-two structural boundaries, and supplies a fully explicit low-degree complement to standard asymptotic squarefree-correlation results. This is not a parameter-renaming or an arbitrary computational slice.
